reason: I run 3+ agents a day and context switching between tools is real pain, but $30/seat adds up fast once the team grows, and I haven't verified Loom on Reddit or GitHub yet. The first five humans are free, so I'd trial it solo before I'd ever pull out my card.
objection: $30/seat adds up fast with 10+ agents, and I don't know if it's actually reliable yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real Reddit/GitHub praise from teams running 3+ agents, or growing past the 5-human free limit and feeling the value firsthand.
